Frequently asked questions

If your question is not here, call us: it is even faster.

How does your invoicing work?

You receive one quote per request, itemising housing, transport and services. Once approved, we book and invoice your company on the terms stated in the quote. Your employees pay nothing up front and you have no expense claims to process.

Why corporate housing rather than a standard rental?

Because a standard French rental is designed to last years: long lease, high deposit, heavy paperwork, an empty flat. Corporate housing is designed for assignments: furnished and equipped, the right duration, booked in the company's name, one point of contact. You save weeks and manage nothing on site.

Do you offer premium services for employees?

Yes: welcome and settling-in, concierge during the stay, sport and activities, family support. À la carte or as a full programme. See wellbeing services.

Can you manage several employees or projects at the same time?

Yes. We house whole teams and follow several assignments in parallel. You keep one contact and a clear view of what is booked, for whom and until when.

I own a property: how do I join your network?

Call us or describe your property through the contact form. We will explain our criteria and, if it fits, arrange a visit. Learn more for property owners.

What types of housing do you offer?

Furnished apartments for stays of a month or more, aparthotels for stays of a few weeks and hotels for short stays or last-minute arrivals. See housing options.

Who are your services for?

Companies and organisations sending employees on assignment to Paris and the Île-de-France region: consulting firms, construction companies, NGOs, SMEs, mid-size companies and international groups. See how we work with each sector.

Which areas do you cover?

Paris and the whole Île-de-France region. For an assignment elsewhere in France, call us and we will quickly tell you whether we can help.

How long does it take to find housing for an employee?

It depends on duration, location and number of people. For an individual request we come back quickly with options. For a team, tell us as early as possible: we will have more choice. In an emergency we can also arrange a hotel for the first nights.

Do you offer a complete corporate mobility service?

Yes: housing, transport and wellbeing services, coordinated by the same team and grouped in the same quote. You can also entrust us with only part of it, for example housing alone.

What time zone are you in, and when can we call?

We are in Paris (Central European Time). Monday–Friday, 9am–6pm (Paris time, CET). Outside those hours, send the form and we will call you back.

Sending people to Paris? Call us.

In ten minutes we will understand your needs and tell you what we can do. In English or French, no commitment.
